jobs.description: Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to ride along with an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. A €150 net Bring a Friend bonus, subject to the applicable conditions. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courieris not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Apply through Consolid for the position of Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

At UPS in Roermond, you will work in a dynamic warehouse environment where no two days are the same. Depending on your experience, certifications and business needs, you may work in different departments such as inbound, outbound, customs support, inventory control or material handling. Your responsibilities may include: ✔️ Receiving and processing incoming goods ✔️ Picking and packing customer orders ✔️ Loading and unloading trucks ✔️ Working with warehouse systems and scanners ✔️ Supporting customs and inventory processes ✔️ Operating warehouse equipment such as EPT, OPT or forklift (if certified) What's in it for you?     - Gross salary of €15.00 per hour including 1.38% ADV allowance    - Shift allowances where applicable     - Travel allowance according to company policy     - Pension accrual via Manpower    - Part-time or full-time position of between approximately 30 and 40 hours per week    - Training and development possibilities     - Temporary contract with Manpower with opportunity for a long-term position    - Good command of the English language, in order to understand the work instructions    - Logistics or warehouse experience is preferred     - MHE, EPT, OPT or Forklift certificates are a plus     - Physically able to perform warehouse activities     - Flexible attitude regarding shifts and departments    - At least 18 years of age because of the working activities and hours    - Able to provide a Certificate of Conduct (VOG)Do you want to start working as a logistics employee at UPS? Then apply today! One of our Manpower recruiters will contact you within two working days!

We offer Gross hourly wage starting from €15.52, depending on your work experience* Salary paid every 4 weeks, resulting in 13 payments per year Travel allowance from 20 kilometres per day of €0.14 per kilometre 8% holiday allowance, paid in May 10% holiday hour accrual and 5% year-end bonus 26 vacation days based on a full-time contract, plus an extra day off on your birthday Multiple fixed-term contract opportunities The opportunity to obtain your SVS Cleaning Diploma (basic cleaning certification) Training and development opportunities to grow into roles such as Supervisor *Gross hourly wage applies to employees aged 20 and over. Your job Together with your colleagues, you ensure that guests enter a fresh and clean room every day. You will: Clean hotel rooms, hallways, and the lobby Change bed linen Clean bathrooms and furniture Vacuum and mop floors Refill guest amenities such as soap and shampoo After every room, you can finish your work with satisfaction, knowing you've contributed to a great guest experience! Working Hours & Days Flexible working days (Monday through Sunday) Working hours between 09:00 and 16:00 15 to 20 hours per week EW Facility Services For over 30 years, we have been providing cleaning and maintenance services for a wide range of buildings, including offices, hotels, and hospitals. We are proud of our team of more than 3,000 employees who work hard every day at locations throughout the Netherlands. Our goal is to make a positive contribution to the experience of our clients' employees, guests, and visitors through our services. You are Flexibly available and willing to work different days and shifts Able to work independently and communicate in Dutch and/or English Detail-oriented and enjoy working in a clean environment Living in Delft or the surrounding area Previous cleaning experience is helpful, but not required. Apply Excited about this opportunity? Ready to get started? Apply today and hopefully we'll meet you soon!
